parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delete all tags.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag to remove. You can specify a maximum of 50 tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc untag-resources --resource-type function --resource-id acs:fc:cn-shanghai:xxx:functions/f1 --tag-key k1 --all true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fc DELETE /2023-03-30/tags-v2 --region cn-hangzhou --All true --ResourceId '["acs:fc:cn-shanghai:xxx:functions/f1"]' --TagKey '["k1"]' --ResourceType function --header "Content-Type=application/json"
